origin.derivedFrom: docs/integrations/idealpos-waiterpad-protocol-contract-2026-09-06.md §7 — the sentinel is replaced only on the equality branch; envelope NOT SHOWN, so the root carries no Type attribute

note: A readback still showing -9999 means IdealPOS never substituted its own price. That is a hard stop — the line is on the table at a sentinel price — not a rounding detail. ENVELOPE CAVEAT: the root element carries NO Type attribute here, because the readback response's envelope is NOT SHOWN. IPS.exe's only 'WPPacket Type = ...' literals are the six order-path response bodies (ACK, NAK, DUPLICATE, LOCK, NAKREGO, NAKPRINT); no 'TABLESTATUS' response type exists anywhere in the binary. What IS proven (contract Sec 13) is the per-row <OrderItem> field set, and only that.
